# Upper

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Strings](BlitzBasic-Strings)

</div>


## Command Syntax

```blitzbasic
Upper:String string:String
```

## Description

Returns a copy of the string with every letter in upper case.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `string` | String | required | The text. |

**Returns:** The upper case text.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Print Upper$("Hello World 1!")
```

```text
HELLO WORLD 1!
```
